title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (3/20): Baoyu and Daiyu Meet
note_en: Baoyu asks 你有没有玉？ "Do you have a jade?" This is an affirmative-negative question: the verb is placed next to its own negative (有 + 没有), and that alone makes it a question, with no 吗 needed. English needs "do" and inversion; in everyday spoken Chinese, 有没有 is often more natural than 你有玉吗.
